# Dr. Michael's Dental Clinic

> Award-winning dental clinic in Dubai offering comprehensive services from family dentistry to advanced implant surgery and cosmetic treatments.

Dr. Michael's Dental Clinic, led by Dr. Michael Formenius and a team of international specialists, has been serving Dubai since 1997. The clinic combines cutting-edge technology like 3D guided implant surgery and Waterlase laser treatment with personalized aesthetic dentistry including the proprietary Couture Smile™ system.
